project.name: QPIO (Curio)
project.objective: Daily general-knowledge challenges, quick-fire quizzes and streaks. Free forever. Zero-dependency progressive web app: privacy-first (measures the pool, never the person — Charter §8), works offline on a cheap phone. Proof of concept that the AI Operating System can run a real project end to end.
